title: Log blowup procedures functorial for arbitrary strict morphisms
statement: Let $D$ be any class of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. A strict log blowup procedure on $D$ assigns to every $X$ in $D$ a finite saturated log blowup tower over $X$, and to every strict log morphism $f:Y\to X$ [def-per-strict-log-morphism] between members a contracted recursive pullback comparison in the sense of [def-trf-strict-etale-log-blowup-procedure], with no etaleness hypothesis. These comparisons retain the ordered nonempty coherent log centers, delete exactly whole-monoid centers, and their count maps and actual log morphisms obey identity and composition. Composition and identity are the canonical log maps of [def-per-log-morphism-composition] and [def-per-log-morphism-identity]. For such a tower $A$, define $A\to X$ at each level recursively, beginning with the identity transported through the initial identification and composing the successive arrows. For the regularization application, the input class consists of the Noetherian separated log regular fs schemes: Noetherian means quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and separatedness uses [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Empty and disconnected schemes are allowed, and no excellence condition is imposed.
